title: An e-bike for a hilly 14-mile-a-day commute under $2,000
prompt: I want an e-bike for a 7-mile commute each way with a couple of real hills, budget under $2,000. I'd like to be able to get it serviced at a normal bike shop. Which one?
note: Goes dark and leads with one pick as a serif pull quote because the shop-serviceability condition made the decision lopsided and the reader wanted a confident answer, not a field guide. The three runners-up sit in one small row under it, and the upgrade slot is dropped with a sentence saying why rather than padded. Criteria carry weight bars so the reader sees that the first criterion outweighed the rest before reading a word.
